title: Proactive Physical AI through Continuous Observation and Timely Intervention
abstract: arXiv:2610.16967v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Physical AI is commonly formulated around an explicitly specified task: given a goal or instruction, a system perceives, reasons, and acts. In many real-world settings, however, important tasks emerge from continuously changing world states before a person explicitly formulates them. We study this complementary problem as Proactive Physical AI, where an AI system continuously observes the physical world, identifies situations that warrant intervention, and initiates appropriate actions at the right time. We develop ProAgent, an end-to-end system built around two components: a Jev-style proactive timing model (dubbed StreamingJev) that determines whether and when intervention is needed, and a Response Model that generates responses for people or invokes available device capabilities for physical execution. To support learning at scale, we develop an automated data pipeline that converts videos into supervision for proactive timing. Expe

translated_title: 通过持续观察与及时干预实现主动式物理人工智能
translated_abstract: 物理人工智能通常围绕明确指定的任务来构建：在给定目标或指令后，系统进行感知、推理并采取行动。然而在许多现实场景中，重要的任务往往在世界状态持续变化的过程中自然涌现，而并非由人们事先明确提出。我们将这一互补性问题定义为“主动式物理人工智能”，即AI系统持续观察物理世界，识别出需要干预的情境，并在恰当的时机主动发起合适的行动。我们开发了ProAgent，一个由两个核心组件构成的端到端系统：一个是Jev风格的主动时机模型（StreamingJev），用于判断是否需要干预以及何时干预；另一个是响应模型，用于为人们生成响应，或调用可用的设备能力以完成物理执行。为支持大规模学习，我们开发了自动化数据流水线，将视频转化为用于主动时机的监督信号。实验（摘要原文在此处截断）……
tldr: 该论文提出“主动式物理人工智能”新范式，构建了由StreamingJev主动时机模型和响应模型组成的端到端系统ProAgent，使AI能够持续观察物理世界并识别情境、在恰当的时机主动进行干预。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Proactive Physical AI and presents ProAgent, an end-to-end system combining a StreamingJev proactive timing model and a response model, enabling AI to continuously observe the physical world and intervene at the right time.
